```{r}

# multiBigwigSummary BED-file \ 
#   --bwfiles \
# "$BW_BM_PN_R1" "$BW_BM_PN_R2" "$BW_BM_PN_R3" \
# "$BW_BM_SA_R1" "$BW_BM_SA_R2" "$BW_BM_SA_R3" \
#   --labels BM_Pn_r1 BM_Pn_r2 BM_Pn_r3 BM_Sa_r1 BM_Sa_r2 BM_Sa_r3 \
#   --BED "$BED" \
#   --outRawCounts "$OUTDIR/BM_selectedgenes_mean.tsv" \
#   -out "$OUTDIR/BM_selectedgenes_mean.npz"

# load libraries
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(pheatmap)
library(scales)

bm <- read_tsv("BM_selectedgenes_mean.tsv")
colnames(bm) <- gsub("'", "", colnames(bm))
colnames(bm)[1:3] <- c("chr", "start", "end")

# coordinates -> gene names
gene_order <- tribble(
  ~chr, ~start, ~end, ~Gene,
  "chr7", 19701501,19701600,"Tomm40",
  "chr7", 19227651,19227700,"Opa3",
  "chr15", 78256801,78256850,"Ncf4",
  "chr1", 40116601,40116650,"Il1r2",
  "chr4", 140902601,140902650,"Padi2",
  "chr5", 17776751,17776800,"Cd36",
  "chr1", 128552801,128552850,"Cxcr4",
  "chr7", 140921401,140921450,"Nlrp6",
  "chr6", 134526551,134526600,"Lrp6",
  "chr16", 23224740,23360348,"St6gal1",
  "chr9", 44580251,44580300,"Cxcr5",
  "chr10",19062751,19062800,"Tnfaip3",
  "chr4", 140854651,140854700,"Padi1"
)

# join file with mapping to add gene names
bm_named <- bm %>%
  inner_join(gene_order, by = c("chr","start","end"))

# reorder rows & columns
bm_named$Gene <- factor(bm_named$Gene, levels = gene_order$Gene)
bm_named <- bm_named %>% arrange(Gene)
bm_named <- bm_named %>%
  select(chr, start, end, Gene,
         BM_Sa_r1, BM_Sa_r2, BM_Sa_r3,
         BM_Pn_r1, BM_Pn_r2, BM_Pn_r3)

# extract matrix & scale
mat <- as.matrix(bm_named %>% select(starts_with("BM_")))
rownames(mat) <- bm_named$Gene
mat_scaled <- t(scale(t(scale(mat))))

pdf("20260227_heatmap_purple.pdf", width = 6.5, height = 8)

pheatmap(
  mat_scaled,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#efedf5","#9e9ac8","#3f007d"))(100),
  angle_col=90,
  border_color = NA,
  labels_row = parse(text = paste0("italic('", rownames(mat_scaled), "')"))
)

dev.off()

```
